messages:
lee: Dropped a small experiment: tool-calling rows in the playground run history now show structured output labels inline (name: value) with an optional "Expand" chevron. Want quick feedback on copy + a11y.

cory: Nice. Quick question: is the structured preview generated from the function schema or from the model output?

lee: It's best-effort from the function schema for now. If the output doesn't match, we fall back to raw text. The preview is truncated to 120 chars.

jules: UX nits: (1) the preview cuts mid-JSON which feels confusing; (2) the chevron target is small on touch.

maya: For (1) we should smart-truncate on token/field boundary (don't slice a JSON key). For (2) increase hit target to 44px and add a visible focus ring.

cory: Copy: current label says "Structured output" which reads vague. Suggest "Structured output preview" or just "Preview (structured)". Short and action oriented.

lee: Leaning to "Preview (structured)". Shorter in a cramped row and aligns with the chevron action.

jules: Accessibility: when expanded, we need aria-expanded on the chevron, role="button", and the expanded region should have aria-labelledby pointing to the chevron so assistive tech announces context. Also add aria-live polite when the preview fails to parse as structured.

maya: Addendum: keyboard behavior - Space/Enter should toggle expansion and focus must move into the expanded region to the first interactive element. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the expand transition.

cory: Microcopy for parse failure: instead of "Unable to parse" maybe "Preview unavailable — output not structured" which is clearer for users.

lee: Good call. Will use "Preview unavailable — output not structured" and include a small inline "View raw" link that opens the full response.

jules: Visual: add a faint key/value glyph to the left of the preview so users can scan rows for structured outputs quickly. Make it decorative (aria-hidden) so SRs don't announce it.

maya: Also propose provenance tag for preview: small badge "schema-derived" vs "model-suggested" so engineers know whether to trust fields. Low-contrast badge with tooltip explaining provenance.

cory: Quick keyboard test plan: tab sequence in run row should be: row selection checkbox -> preview toggle -> first action (View raw / Copy) -> next control. No tab traps. I'll run and report.

deploy-bot: staging deploy: playground-structured-preview-1757755511 succeeded :white_check_mark:

lee: I'll implement truncation-at-boundary, expand a11y attributes, hit target bump, and switch label to "Preview (structured)". Thanks for the sharp notes — merging in ~30m unless blockers.

jules: Tiny copy nit: tooltip for the provenance badge should read "Source: inferred from function schema" not "from schema". More explicit helps new users.

lee: Noted. Will use your tooltip copy. Ping me if you spot anything else after the deploy. :rocket:
